COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
WPMS/3280/2025
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey, learned
counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Suyash Pant, learned Standing
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for
the respondent-HRDA.
4. Petitioner applied for compounding
of a non-residential building to Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority (HRDA).
His application was rejected by the
Competent Authority, vide order dated
20.11.2025. Thus, feeling aggrieved,
petitioner has approached this Court.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that although the order
impugned is appealable before the
Chairman, HRDA, however, on account of
Lawyers strike, petitioner is not able to
file appeal.
6. Learned State Counsel, however,
submits that Lawyers of Haridwar are not
on strike, and as per his information,
some Lawyers, practicing at Dehradun
have abstained from work on account of
their demand regarding Chamber. Thus,
he submits that excuse taken by
petitioner for not approaching the
Appellate Authority is factually incorrect.
7. Be that as it may, when the
petitioner has remedy of appeal,
therefore, this Court is not inclined to

2025:UHC:10523
entertain this petition.
8. As per the Statute, limitation of 30
days is available to petitioner. Since
appeal filed by petitioner would be within
time upto 20.12.2025, therefore, the writ
petition is disposed of by providing that
no coercive action shall be taken against
the petitioner till 20.12.2025. If
petitioner files appeal against the
rejection of his compounding map, the
same shall be considered, as early as
possible. However, petitioner shall not
raise any construction over the land in
question and he shall have to submit an
undertaking in the form of an affidavit to
that effect.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 26.11.2025
Aswal
